card.name: Computing and web terms, mixed contexts
card.fires_on: Words in tech and web-related text, often just before a computing term such as webmaster, lag, shell, key or hotfix. The marked word is often a small modifier or the start of a compound.

modes.label: Start of web/tech compound
modes.description: First part of a compound word like webmaster, login shell or hotfixes.

modes.label: Modifier before a tech noun
modes.description: A small word like unnecessary, that or somehow in a sentence about servers, keys or web attacks.
modes.example: this will add<< unnecessary>> lag-time to your game.

card.writes: It pushes up software interface terms like UI, hover, whitelist and payload, and pushes down general words like program, computer and Internet.
